name: inventory-yaml-mapping

graded_by.test: owed by the E3 schema plan (the loader reads every tree)

description: Rule 10 of the target schema's x-layout, the YAML data model: a reader parses a target file as YAML and checks the JSON form in which every scalar of a key the schema types as a string is that scalar's text. One file carries an unquoted last_seen date-time, which a YAML 1.1 reader reads as a timestamp, and an unquoted on in name, which it reads as a boolean. Both load as strings, so the file is valid and enters the index: the discovery writer (Python, YAML 1.1) and the core (Go, YAML 1.2) read the same file. The rule is executable in tsbc (_inventory.inventory_read); this case is its record. A tags item is typed a string too, so an unquoted on or 123 in tags is that text, not a boolean or a number. `alerts` is the reader's report of what it refused; the core writes each as a log line (x-layout identity-and-refusals, missing-current).
